decisive_finding.detail: RunnerObservation accepts caller-supplied symbolic identity, executable path, digest, length, and mode. Binding compares that observation only with a selected identity derived from the same caller-controlled values, so a selected tool named true with the real identity of /usr/bin/false is accepted.
decisive_finding.observed_result: bind_selected returned Ok for symbolic tool true backed by /usr/bin/false; the refusal assertion failed

preserved_evidence.candidate_identity: all four rows, permissions, regular single-link identities, totals, aggregate, and JSON schema validation matched
preserved_evidence.source_proof: the exact candidate compiled and the existing inconsistent-digest mutation control remains useful but incomplete
preserved_evidence.root_authority_unchanged: no public command process execution root grant durable registry installed behavior or claim authority was added

required_behavior: anchor each adopted symbolic tool to exact executable and content authority independent of caller observation
reject same-name different-path and caller-consistent different-executable substitutions
preserve exact positive runner and unsupported-host refusal behavior
validate the corrected receipt with the authoritative Rust WorkerResultV1 parser

claim_ceiling: identity-frozen source-local catalog candidate that compiles but is not an exact production runner boundary pending correction and rereview
explicitly_withheld: source-local catalog acceptance and mediator compatibility
public execution process effects and root grants
durable registry installed and real-user behavior
readiness release node closure and completion
no_claim_statement: This REWORK decision does not claim source acceptance, public execution, installation, real-user behavior, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
